verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas Editor is a browser-based visual environment with viewport-based scene composition, live editing, real-time collaboration, prefabs/asset management, checkpoints, and a scriptable Editor API for automation/extension — matching the technical-artist workflow of viewport + inspector + prefab/scene composition. Community evidence corroborates its scene editor as a genuine, well-regarded tool (though with some dev-experience gripes around offline/local dev unrelated to editor core functionality). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on review specifically praising the inspector/prefab workflow in depth, and community comments raise some friction (e.g., offline editing limitations) that slightly cap quality.
